change: Replace the single optional contract-group sheet with a canonical set. Board and profile CLIs accept repeated --contract-group-face-sheet for distinct sheets. Generate every eligible sheet's offers; after packing failure, expand eligible suffix orientations together and perform one combined replan. Keep successful incumbents and complete failed/partial-expansion accounting.
validation: Reject duplicate CLI names and every unknown additional sheet. Existing compact-mode, geometry, controlled-net, connector/top-access and external-contract eligibility checks remain active. Selecting an ineligible sheet does not weaken its restrictions or suppress eligible sheets.

tests.multi_sheet_geometry: USB-JTAG and power-monitor combined offers equal independent per-sheet offers; second sheet contributes actual candidates; unrelated and ineligible power-sheet geometry unchanged; reordering selections reproduces geometry and receipts.
tests.operation_accounting: Independent instrumented scalar entries equal reported counts. Combined per-operation work equals the sum of single-sheet runs minus their common baseline.
tests.recovery: Single- and multi-sheet success, exhausted recovery, injected exceptions and invalid specifications preserve complete receipts. One orientation-retry event per combined wave, not per sheet.
tests.test_correction: Injected packing failures now reject both reservation passes before expecting parent orientation recovery. This follows the previous two-policy fixes; the old one-pass expectation no longer exercised the intended path.
